value: Made as a dry or sweet white, alone or blended, and as a traditional method sparkling wine; it may also go into the rosés.
source_notes: RVO dossier 2.6.2: Johanniter in white wine (dry, sweet), mousserende kwaliteitswijn, and possibly in rosé and rosé parelwijn. OJ C 94/2020 single document: same categories (white dry/sweet, quality sparkling white, rosé possibly with Johanniter). Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Here it smells of ripe fruit such as yellow apple rather than green fruit, and stays fruity and fresh.
source_notes: RVO dossier: geur citrus en rijpe appels; smaak fruitig, fris. OJ C 94/2020: Johanniter and Souvignier Gris wines have an aroma of ripe fruit, such as yellow apples; taste fruity and fresh. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a dry or sweet red, a barrel aged red, a rosé, a red liqueur wine and a semi sparkling rosé, alone or blended with the other red grapes.
source_notes: RVO dossier 2.6.2: Regent listed for red (dry, sweet, barrique), rosé, likeurwijn rood, parelwijn rosé. OJ C 94/2020: Regent in red dry/sweet, red barrel aged, rosé, liqueur wine red, aerated semi sparkling rosé, "or a coupage thereof". Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a dry or sweet white, a barrel aged white and a sparkling wine, and as a sweet wine from raisined or overripe grapes.
source_notes: RVO dossier: Solaris in white (dry, sweet, barrique), mousserende kwaliteitswijn, categories 15 and 16. OJ C 94/2020: Solaris in white dry/sweet, white barrel aged (Solaris only), quality sparkling, wine from raisined grapes and from overripe grapes (Solaris). Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Here it shows mango and ripe pineapple held by a refreshing acidity, and turns creamy when aged in barrel.
source_notes: RVO dossier: geur inlandse vruchten en tropisch fruit zoals mango of rijpe ananas; smaak frisheid van het zuur; barrique gives vanilla and makes the wine filmend. OJ C 94/2020: aroma native fruits and tropical fruits such as mango or ripe pineapple; acidic freshness; barrels give woody notes and creamy taste. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a dry or sweet white, alone or blended, and as a traditional method sparkling wine.
source_notes: RVO dossier: Souvignier Gris in white wine and mousserende kwaliteitswijn. OJ C 94/2020: white dry/sweet and quality sparkling white (traditional method), or a coupage. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Here it is fuller bodied than the other whites, with ripe yellow fruit such as yellow apple.
source_notes: RVO dossier: geur rijpe gele vruchten; smaak volle wijn, licht fruitig en fris. OJ C 94/2020: ripe fruit such as yellow apples; Souvignier Gris wines are fuller bodied. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a dry single variety white; the rules describe blends as possible but the exception.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: "Monocépages karakteriseren de wijnsoort" / "characterised by varietals"; "Een assemblage is eerder een uitzonderling, maar mogelijk" / "Assemblage is possible, but something of an exception"; Auxerrois taste dry. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Here it is pale lemon and dry, with ripe yellow apple and sometimes green pear, and a finish that is intense and long in most years.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: colour light lemon yellow; nose ripe yellow apples, sometimes green pears; taste dry, fine soft acidity; finish intense and long in most years. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a dry single variety white, sometimes matured in wood with lees stirring.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: varietal wines, blends the exception; straw to golden "effect of wood"; complex aromas "by batonnage"; can take on a broader flavour when matured in wood. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: On the Maas gravel it gains a pronounced minerality and particularly refined acidity, with lemon and sometimes honeydew melon or apricot, and a long mineral finish.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: nose lemon, sometimes honeydew melon, apricot; the gravel produces pronounced minerality; particularly refined acids; gravel subsoil basis of long mineral intensity. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a single variety white; the rules describe blends as possible but the exception.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: varietal wines; blends the exception. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Here it smells of yellow pear, honey and spice, with pepper, flint and a little smoke, and its subtle acidity is balanced by a touch of honey.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: nose yellow pears, honey (sometimes almond), spices, pepper and flint with a little smokiness; taste balance between subtle acids typical of Maasvallei Limburg and a note of honey, long finish. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a single variety white; the rules describe blends as possible but the exception.

value: The Maas gravel gives it a smoky, mineral taste with a hint of spice over white peach and apple, and with age petrol and honey come forward.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: nose white stone fruits (peach) and apples; the gravel gives a smoky mineral taste with a hint of spice; when mature petroleum and honey predominate. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Here the reds run from ruby to pomegranate, adding black cherry and wild blackberry to red berries, with velvety ripe tannins that let them age up to ten years.
source_notes: RVO dossier 4.2.2 and OJ C 278/2017 single document (section 4) carry the same per variety text: colour ruby to pomegranate (robijnrood tot granaatrood); red berries, raspberries, black cherries and wild blackberries; velvety soft ripe tannins; can mature up to 10 years in bottle. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a still white fermented cool in steel, and as a traditional method sparkling wine.
source_notes: OJ C 296/2017 single document sections 4 and 5, and RVO dossier ("Typiciteit ... in het Mergelland"): Auxerrois listed under wine category 1 white and category 5 quality sparkling; practice "aroma by cold fermentation in steel"; sparkling by traditional method. Dossier: gegist op roestvrijstalen vaten; mousserende kwaliteitswijn volgens de traditionele methode. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a still white, often through malolactic fermentation and ageing in wooden casks, and as a traditional method sparkling wine.
source_notes: OJ C 296/2017 single document sections 4 and 5, and RVO dossier ("Typiciteit ... in het Mergelland"): "Secondary aromas often by malolactic fermentation and ageing in wooden casks"; category 5 traditional method. Dossier: gegist op RVS en eikenhout; boter door melkzuurgisting, toast en vanille door hout. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Mergelland Chardonnay is medium bodied, with lemon fruit and, from the oak many producers use, toast and vanilla.
source_notes: OJ C 296/2017 single document sections 4 and 5, and RVO dossier ("Typiciteit ... in het Mergelland"): OJ taste: lemon, butter, toast, vanilla, medium body. Dossier: citroen, soms suikermeloen; toast en vanille door hout; medium body; keeps freshness after malolactic and oak. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a still white fermented cool in steel, and as a traditional method sparkling wine.
source_notes: OJ C 296/2017 single document sections 4 and 5, and RVO dossier ("Typiciteit ... in het Mergelland"): Rivaner/Müller-Thurgau under category 1 white and category 5; "aroma by cold fermentation in steel"; traditional method. Dossier: op roestvrijstalen vaten gegist; mousserende kwaliteitswijn van Rivaner. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Here it carries a muscat note over ripe apple and white peach.

Dossier: intens vleugje muskaat (bij lage opbrengst), rijpe appels en witte steenvruchten (perzik). Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a still white fermented in steel and sometimes aged in wooden casks, and as a traditional method sparkling wine.

Dossier: RVS, some producers age a small share in oak; mousserende kwaliteitswijn van Pinot Gris. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: The rosés can show a note of ripe tomato beside raspberry and strawberry, and the white wines pear and yellow fruit with a hint of red berries.
source_notes: OJ C 296/2017 single document sections 4 and 5, and RVO dossier ("Typiciteit ... in het Mergelland"): OJ rosé Pinot Noir: raspberries, strawberries, sometimes ripe tomatoes; white Pinot Noir: pears, yellow fruits, sometimes a hint of strawberries and raspberries. Dossier: rosé frambozen, aardbeien en soms rijpe tomaat; wit peer, geel fruit, soms vleug aardbei en framboos. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a still white fermented cool in steel, and as a traditional method sparkling wine.

Dossier: op roestvrijstalen vaten gegist; mousserende kwaliteitswijn van Riesling. Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a lively, racy single variety white, light and low in alcohol.
source_notes: Cahier des charges (Ministry of Agriculture, appellation rules) b)1 and f): whites vinified as single varieties, Elbling among the "vifs et racés"; Elbling gives "vins légers de consommation courante". Vins & Crémants Luxembourg (national promotion body, c/o Institut viti-vinicole): lively wine, valued for its low alcohol content.

value: A modern Luxembourg Elbling is lively and low in alcohol, with citrus and pomegranate beside the green apple.
source_notes: Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: modern Elbling lively, crispy, citrus, gooseberry, green apple, pomegranate, low alcohol. luxembourg.public.lu (government information portal): lively, citrus, redcurrant, green apple, pomegranate, low alcohol. The two texts are near identical, so independence is limited.

value: Made as an easy, everyday single variety white in the rounder, more aromatic style.
source_notes: Cahier des charges: Rivaner among the "plus ronds et aromatiques"; "vins gouleyants", best drunk young. Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: popular consumer wines for uncomplicated, day to day enjoyment; white page groups Rivaner with the round and aromatic wines.

value: In Luxembourg it is light and soft, with a characteristic muscat note.
source_notes: Cahier des charges: "une agréable note de muscat et une légère acidité". luxembourg.public.lu: fruity, light and soft, with characteristic notes of muscatel.

value: Made as a single variety white in the rounder, more aromatic style, and also as late harvest and straw wine.
source_notes: Cahier des charges: Auxerrois among the "plus ronds et aromatiques"; allowed for vendanges tardives and vin de paille (section c). Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: white wines page groups Auxerrois with round and aromatic; late vintage page lists Auxerrois for straw wine and late harvest.

value: Here it is fresh and fruity with a delicate acidity, and the best wines keep for years and can recall white Burgundy.
source_notes: Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: style rather mellow, fresh and fruity, complex; can evolve into long keeping wine reminiscent of white Burgundy. luxembourg.public.lu: crisp, fruity, delicate acidity; wines for cellaring not unlike Burgundy whites. Shared text origin likely.

value: An important base wine for Crémant de Luxembourg, also made as a lively single variety white and as late harvest, straw and ice wine.
source_notes: Crémant base: Vins & Crémants Luxembourg ("important basic wine for Crémant") and luxembourg.public.lu ("important as the base for crémant"). Lively single variety white: cahier des charges (vifs et racés) and Vins & Crémants. Late harvest, straw, ice wine: cahier des charges section c and Vins & Crémants late vintage page.

value: Here it is racy with a fine minerality, turning smooth and buttery when raised in oak.
source_notes: Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: racy, lively playful acidity, fine minerality; in oak the fruit shifts to buttery, melting notes. luxembourg.public.lu: delicately fruity and mineral; in wood fruity notes give way to smooth buttery aromas.

value: Made as a single variety white in the rounder, more aromatic style, and also as late harvest, straw and ice wine.
source_notes: Cahier des charges: Pinot gris among the "plus ronds et aromatiques"; allowed for vendanges tardives, vin de paille and vin de glace. Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: round and aromatic group; late vintage page lists Pinot gris for ice wine, straw wine and late harvest.

value: Made as a lively, racy single variety white, and also as late harvest and ice wine.
source_notes: Cahier des charges: Riesling among the "vifs et racés"; allowed for vendanges tardives and vin de glace (also vin de paille, which the promotion body does not list, so left out). Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: dry, late vintage or ice wine; late vintage page lists Riesling for ice wine and late harvest.

value: Grown on shell limestone, it is intensely mineral and less fruity than Riesling from slate, with citrus, apple and quince and a spicy edge.
source_notes: Vins & Crémants Luxembourg: breathes the shell limestone soil; intense minerality, less fruity than wines from slate; citrus, apple, apricot, quince, spicy overtones. luxembourg.public.lu: intense minerality from the chalky soil; less fruity than on shale; citrus, apple, quince, spicy aromas. Shared text origin likely.

value: Here it smells of fresh apple and grapefruit, with balanced acidity and great length, and the sparkling version opens grassy.
source_notes: OJ C 199/2018 single document and RVO dossier 2.4.2 (same text): aroma fresh apple and grapefruit; taste good balance of acidity and great length; sparkling: initially grassy (stuivende grassige aanzet). Both texts come from the same applicant file, published by RVO (Dutch ministry) and by the European Commission in the Official Journal.

value: Made as a barrel aged red, alone or blended with Regent and Cabertin, and also into rosé, a red liqueur wine and a semi sparkling rosé.

value: Aged in barrel here, it turns spicy and concentrated, with black cherry fruit and great length.
